text:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-14 requires PK subgroup visits V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6 ±1), V2.3 (Day 10 ±1), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80 ±1), and V8.1 (Day 90 ±2), but no operations add these events or assign the PK form to them."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-01",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 27,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-01 adds '480 h' to the PKTPT codelist, but its cited quote on page 27 only covers the 1st dose timepoints up to 240 h and does not mention 480 h (which appears in the 6th dose bullet below it)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-20",
      "change_id": "CH-17",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-20 assigns the Physical Examination (PE) form to V2 instead of V1.1, contradicting Table 1 (p. 45) and footnote i (p. 46), which schedule physical examination/body weight at Visits 1, 1.1, 4, 6, 8, and 9, and not at Visit 2."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-27",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-27 assigns the LAB form to V1 and V2, omitting V1.1 where Clinical laboratory tests and the Screening serum pregnancy test are actually scheduled in Table 1 (p. 45; also Section 6.2.2 p. 49), while collecting all consolidated items (including C. difficile, urine drug screen, pregnancy, and biomarkers) at every visit V1 through V9 regardless of their distinct schedules."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-25",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-25 adds Urine Drug Screening (UDSRES) and OP-26 adds Biomarkers (BIOMRES), but neither assessment appears in the cited quote on page 45 (Urine drug screening is on page 44)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-28",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-28, OP-29, OP-30, OP-31, OP-34, and OP-35 add and assign the CLIN form for Vital Signs, 12-lead ECG, Alcohol/Tobacco Habits, and Concomitant Medications while citing a quote for Clinical laboratory tests, Pregnancy test, and C. difficile that does not support any of those items or their visit schedules."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-35",
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-35 assigns the consolidated CLIN form (containing Vitals, ECG, Habits, Diary dispensing/review, and ConMeds) to all visits V0 through V9, contradicting Table 1 (pp. 44-45) where V0 has none of these assessments, V2 has no Vitals or ECG, Habits is only at V1, Diary dispensing is not at V0/V8/V9, and Diary review is not at V0/V1/V9."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-36",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is internally inconsistent on the screening endoscopy window: Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34), Table 1 footnote c (p. 45), and Section 6.2.2 bullet 9 (p. 49) specify Day -35 to Day -6 prior to Randomisation, whereas Section 6.2.2 paragraph 3 on page 49 still states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable'."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-37",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-37 opens a query whenever infusion duration is not exactly 2 hours, yet Appendix 4 (p. 94) explains that the '±3 min' text was removed because 'For some sites, it may be difficult to control the dosing time within ±3 min', leaving it ambiguous whether sites should be queried for any deviation from 2.00 hours or allowed a wider tolerance."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-10",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-38",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-38 restricts only the 48 h, 144 h, 240 h, and 480 h PK timepoints when PKSUB = 'No', whereas Table 1 footnote e (p. 45) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51) state that all PK blood sampling is 'For Mainland China PK subgroup only' (and even if non-subgroup patients have peak/trough samples, 0.5 h, 1 h, and 6 h are also PK-subgroup-only); additionally, its cited quote on page 26 does not mention these timepoints or parent visits V2, V7, and V8."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-11",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-18",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is inconsistent on Screening pregnancy testing: Table 1 (pp. 44-45) marks Pregnancy test at Visit 1.1 (Day -5 to -1), whereas footnote h (p. 46) and Section 7.1.4 (p. 55) state 'Serum pregnancy test at Visit 1' (while Section 6.2.2 p. 49 lists Serum beta-HCG pregnancy test at Visit 1.1)."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "The exact runtime semantics of rule helper functions like days_between() and hours_between() (e.g., sign convention and integer truncation versus fractional hours) and whether dynamic per-item visibility exists on consolidated forms could not be verified from the casebook summary."
}
